snippet.title: How to Build a Fruitful Relationship with Jesus
snippet.description:
From our special bonus episode of the Jubilee Church Podcast, Pastor Bryan Mowrey and Jordan Dillon share simple but powerful ways to cultivate a vibrant, Christ-centered life. 

They share actionable tips for growing closer to Jesus—practices that nurture your heart, mind, and actions so your life naturally produces godly fruit.

📺 Watch the full conversation here: https://youtu.be/hP4FG_Z3I3w
